name: Chills: Resume Tailoring & Recruiter Email
desc: Tailor a LaTeX resume to any job with every change approved in a diff, then email the recruiter with it attached. Employers and dates are frozen, edits are spliced by byte range, and an allow-list sanitizer blocks \input and \write18.

name: Chills v1: AI Outreach Engine
desc: The first version of Chills: parses resumes into JSON (with an OCR fallback for scanned PDFs), researches each company, classifies its sector and drafts outreach emails through a multi-provider LLM router with retries, backoff and output validation.

name: RAG Recommendation Agent
desc: Conversational agent that recommends assessments from a 32-page catalogue it scrapes itself: pre-LLM guardrails, MiniLM embeddings and FAISS retrieval, Gemini Flash, then post-LLM validation, behind a FastAPI chat endpoint.

name: RIFX: Rider Infinity Trading Engine
desc: Python research and execution engine on MetaTrader 5: 14 strategy modules (including regime switching and a plain-text rule DSL), an evaluation matrix, a five-gate risk manager, AI news sentiment, backtesting and grid-search optimisation on AWS Spot fleets, walk-forward checks, multi-bot threads and a Flask dashboard.

name: SyncWave Audio
desc: Windows desktop app that plays one system-audio stream on several Bluetooth or wired devices at once, with adaptive buffering and per-device latency controls.

name: Rider Infinity Studio Website
desc: Website for my independent software studio: a Three.js particle scene with GSAP scroll animation, deployed on Vercel.

name: Duplicate Image Scanner
desc: Offline Windows app that finds images that are really the same picture, even renamed, resized, re-saved in another format or flipped. Side-by-side comparison, spreadsheet export, and it never deletes anything.

name: Tokins: Live Queue & AI Admin Platform
desc: A live queue and AI admin SaaS for clinics, pharmacies, retail and service centres, used by 100+ businesses. Real-time queues over Socket.io, Redis caching, Razorpay payments, Firebase auth, and LLM-driven marketing over email, Telegram, Instagram and voice.

name: CareMate: AI Healthcare App
desc: A Django healthcare app with AI diet recommendations, disease prediction using ML models, dashboards, and WhatsApp integration.

name: Top ATS Resume
desc: Full-stack app for creating LaTeX-based resumes with secure authentication and efficient rendering. A precursor to Chills.

name: FinanceTracker
desc: A C# and .NET 8 web app for tracking income and expenses, with local JSON data storage.

name: Shape Calculator
desc: A C# and ASP.NET Core web app for calculating shapes, with local JSON storage and a Bootstrap 5 frontend.

name: Text Emotion Classifier
desc: Detects the emotion in a piece of text and replies with advice: a Keras classifier in a Python backend plus a Node service calling Hugging Face inference models.

name: 5G Resource Allocation Model
desc: Predicts spectrum and power allocation from bandwidth, latency, power, SNR and interference with a small Keras network trained on generated network data.

name: WaitWise (Tokins v1)
desc: The second iteration of the queue idea that became Tokins: QR-code queueing with React, Socket.io and Firebase.

name: Smart Surveillance Object Detection System
desc: Real-time object detection on an ESP32-CAM with OpenCV deep-learning models, analysing live video at up to 30 FPS. Published at IEEE AIIoT 2024.

name: Dynamic Exam Paper Distribution System
desc: Admin web app for Lastone that uploads exam papers to AWS S3 and syncs them to the Android app through Firebase.

name: MERN Blog with Admin Panel
desc: A full-stack blogging platform with user authentication, an admin panel, and content management via Sanity.

name: Optimized Train Seat Allocation System
desc: MERN stack system for train seat management with real-time availability and allocation logic.

name: Kanban Board
desc: React Kanban board for task management, with customizable grouping and sorting.

name: Data Processing API and Frontend
desc: Full-stack app with a REST API for data processing and a frontend for visualising the results.

name: MERN TODO App
desc: A MERN stack TODO app with simple CRUD operations.

name: Indian-Language Speech Synthesis
desc: Trained a VITS text-to-speech model for a non-Hindi Indian language on AI4Bharat data using Colab GPUs, with a reproducible setup guide.

name: Lastone: Academic Android App
desc: An Android app that gives VIT students previous-year exam papers by course code, with 10K+ downloads on Google Play and Firebase authentication.

name: Flipkart Clone
desc: A fully responsive MVP version of Flipkart with basic e-commerce functionality.

name: First Portfolio Website
desc: My first portfolio website, built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript and hosted on AWS S3.

name: PsychiAssist: AI Mental Health Tool
desc: An AI-powered platform using an ML model to predict the level of neurological disorders in individuals.
